message:
RMC-006: declared or dispatched anchor; dispatch-only acquisition

An incremental refresh (RMC-010) needs RMC-006 at a later anchor A1. The
anchor was fixed in code.

- `anchor_from_flags`: the declared anchor unless both `--anchor-number`
  and `--anchor-hash` name another block. Giving one of them is refused.
  `run_current_surface`, `HistoryPlan::mainnet_at`, `run_history` and the
  resume check take the anchor; the declared one stays the default.
- The history step now refuses a current-surface report observed at another
  anchor than its plan.
- Workflow:
  - `workflow_dispatch` inputs `anchor_number` / `anchor_hash`.
  - At the declared anchor the measured 67 reserves are still required. At
    any other anchor, the reserve count read from the three-provider current
    surface must be reproduced by the history and the closeout.
  - The evidence artifact is named by anchor, exact head, run and attempt.
  - Live acquisition runs only from `workflow_dispatch`, in
    nqc-census-public-rpc. A `pull_request` run executes every gate except
    the acquisition, in a per-ref group, and cannot displace a pending
    acquisition.
  - The job timeout rises from 90 to 240 minutes. The offline crash/resume
    matrix is sequential per case, and run 36619916268 spent over 50
    minutes in it.
- The five crash/resume cases share nothing (own store, own transport) and
  now run concurrently. Every case is checked exactly as before and reported
  in cut order.

Tests: the history suite has 11 tests (+1: a current surface from another
anchor is refused), plus a unit test for the anchor flags. The synthetic
current reports now carry their anchor as live reports do. The workspace
passes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
